question: Six boxes, J, K, L, M, N and O, are kept one over the other, but not necessarily in the same order. J is kept immediately above N. Only one box is kept between K and O. O is the bottom-most box, and M is the top-most box. Which box is kept immediately below M?
solution:
**Boxes:** J, K, L, M, N and O

According to the given information:

 
• M is the top-most box & O is the bottom-most box.
